== Sheet text check, 8 November 2026 ==
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf res.starwarsccg.org], header "Official text as of May 11, 2012", PDF built 18 July 2012; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020185537/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]) shows on the card image itself: "At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here (even if inactive)." This page's text, the PC website card list (captures from 2012-07-21) and the undated PC Legacy card data lack "(even if inactive)"; GEMP follows the card data. Earlier research disagreed on whether the slip has the clause (the 2026-11-07 slip audit said only the Master List has it); the rendered sheet page has it. So the sheet and the Master List agree and no Master List errata exists for this card. Not changed here: Bill to rule whether this page should show the sheet text with "(even if inactive)" as the original, and whether the card-list wording without it was ever errata. ''Superseded by the note of 8 November 2026 below.'' [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 12:57, 8 November 2026 (UTC)

== Versions ruling, 8 November 2026 ==
* Bill ruled on 8 November 2026 that the text on the PC card image, without "(even if inactive)", is the original printed text; it stays on [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)|Scoundrel's Luck]]. The re-made Virtual Block 8.1 sheet (PDF built 18 July 2012) and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) add "(even if inactive)". That text is errata PC-E1 and the current text, now on [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)]]. The note above, which called the sheet text the original and said that no Master List errata exists, is superseded. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 18:29, 8 November 2026 (UTC)
